Definition: of uncertain affinity; short (of time, place, quantity, or number):--few words, little (space, while).
BiblicalUsage: brachýs is simply short, of time, place, or number. Scripture uses it in Acts, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that brachýs is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
